# Thistledown Market stall fees

Daily collections are logged per section on market days (Tuesdays and Saturdays) and are complete for September. Seasonal stallholders are billed monthly instead.
Monthly invoicing moved to the new membership software on 18 September; invoices raised after that haven't been entered here yet - the treasurer expects them once the software's first import runs in early October.
